facts.text: The hotel is positioned at Praça do Comércio, in the heart of Lisbon.
facts.excerpt: Exquisitely positioned at Praça do Comércio, at the very heart of Lisbon, Andaz Lisbon captures the essence of the city’s storied past.

facts.text: The hotel's buildings were once home to a mix of residences and financial institutions.
facts.excerpt: Once home to a medley of residences and financial institutions, this architectural gem now unites centuries of history under one roof.

facts.text: The hotel is in Lisbon's Baixa district, an area known for its squares, historic landmarks and shopping streets.
facts.excerpt: Andaz Lisbon is nestled in the heart of the dynamic Baixa district, a lively area renowned for its majestic squares, historic landmarks, and vibrant shopping streets.

facts.text: The Chiado and Bairro Alto neighborhoods are a short stroll from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: A short stroll away, the bohemian enclaves of Chiado and Bairro Alto invite you to discover a world of art galleries, cultural treasures, and eclectic dining options.

facts.text: The Landmark View Premium rooms overlook Praça do Comércio or São Jorge Castle.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy iconic views from our King Bed Landmark View Premium Room, overlooking Praça do Comércio or São Jorge Castle

facts.text: The Rua Augusta View rooms overlook the Rua Augusta pedestrian street.
facts.excerpt: Experience vibrant city views from our king bed room overlooking the lively Rua Augusta pedestrian street, blending comfort with dynamic scenery.

facts.text: The King Bed Premium rooms have two or more windows that bring in natural light.
facts.excerpt: featuring two or more windows that flood the space with natural light

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a separate bedroom and a living room with a dining area.
facts.excerpt: The most premium suite in the hotel with a separate bedroom, TV 65 in the living room, living with a dining area

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a 4.7-metre ceiling.
facts.excerpt: bathtub, ceiling 4.7m, royal size bed 210x200

facts.text: The suites include Loft Suites.
facts.excerpt: Discover expansive luxury in our Large Loft Suite, where modern elegance meets ample space.

facts.text: The rooms and suites combine modern design with local character.
facts.excerpt: Each space seamlessly combines modern sophistication with local character

facts.text: Luzzi is the hotel's rooftop restaurant and terrace lounge.
facts.excerpt: Luzzi, the Signature Rooftop Restaurant and Terrace lounge

facts.text: Luzzi serves modern Lusitanian cuisine, with a menu reflecting Portugal's influence from Goa and Macau to São Paulo.
facts.excerpt: From Goa and Macau to São Paulo, the menu reflects Portugal’s far-reaching impact on both local and global culinary traditions.

facts.text: The Andaz Lounge has live music.
facts.excerpt: Andaz Lounge represents the modern urban locale. Feel the local vibe with live music

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Center: Maintain your fitness regimen during your stay at our cutting-edge fitness center.

facts.text: Pets are welcome, with a bed, bowl and treats provided.
facts.excerpt: Includes bed, bowl, treats, & cuddles.

facts.text: Height, breed and weight restrictions apply to pets.

facts.text: Guest parking is at the Praça do Município Parking, about three minutes away by car.
